method: Keyword/issue-reference search followed by changed-file and targeted actual-diff comparison. Not an exhaustive review of every open PR or every line of these PRs.
limits: GitHub text search does not search all PR diffs and may miss unmentioned fixes. Re-check at submission; new commits/PRs can appear after these pinned heads.
result: Withdraw duplicate SANA VAE candidate. No same-root fix found among inspected PR heads for the remaining three candidates. vLLM full pretrained-model validation still pending.
